content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the inability to resize images using the +/- keys in no-scaling mode, which was introduced by a previous commit. The logic for scaling was incorrectly implemented, preventing the expected behavior when the application was not in fullscreen mode. The patch modifies the conditions under which scaling occurs, allowing resizing in no-scaling mode when certain conditions are met, thus restoring the intended functionality.
